name: threadkeepai
description: Read your trusted ThreadKeepAI project context: decisions, facts, preferences and next actions you saved and checked in ThreadKeepAI. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
ThreadKeepAI keeps the useful parts of your AI conversations in one place: facts, decisions (with the reasoning), working preferences, next actions and open questions, organised by project workspace. You check each record and mark what you trust, so AI suggestions never become "truth" without you.

This plugin lets ChatGPT read that context when you ask, instead of copying and pasting a handoff into every new chat.

- Load a project's handoff: your trusted records for that workspace, the same briefing as ThreadKeepAI's Copy handoff, plus open questions and a note of what was left out.
- Search your saved context: find what you decided or recorded about a topic, across workspaces or in one. Trusted records come first; drafts are clearly labelled as unconfirmed.
- List your workspaces: names, goals and how many records are trusted.

Read-only: ChatGPT can't change, add or delete anything in ThreadKeepAI. You sign in with your ThreadKeepAI account and approve the connection on ThreadKeepAI's own page, and each request is checked against your account, so ChatGPT only ever sees your own workspaces.

You need a ThreadKeepAI account: create one at threadkeepai.com.
defaultPrompt: What ThreadKeepAI workspaces do I have?
Load my project's handoff from ThreadKeepAI.
What did I decide about this? Check ThreadKeepAI.

positive.prompt: What ThreadKeepAI workspaces do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_workspaces and names the "Reviewer Test" workspace (Sample Workspace for Store Reviewers) with 3 records, all 3 trusted.

positive.prompt: Load my Reviewer Test handoff from ThreadKeepAI.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_handoff for "Reviewer Test" and presents the handoff: the balcony gets about six hours of afternoon sun (fact), use drip irrigation instead of sprinklers (decision), prefer drought-tolerant low-care plants (preference).

positive.prompt: What did I decide about watering? Check ThreadKeepAI.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_context with a query about watering and answers: use drip irrigation instead of sprinklers, labelled as a trusted decision.

positive.prompt: According to my ThreadKeepAI notes, how much sun does my balcony get?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_context (e.g. "balcony sun") and answers: about six hours of afternoon sun, labelled trusted.

positive.description: Use saved context to help with a task
positive.prompt: Using my ThreadKeepAI context, suggest three plants for my balcony.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the Reviewer Test context (get_handoff, or search_context) and suggests plants that fit it: about six hours of sun, drip irrigation, drought-tolerant and low care.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Phoenix today?
negative.expected_behavior: ThreadKeepAI is not used: the request has nothing to do with the user's saved project context.

negative.description: Request to delete data (the plugin is read-only)
negative.prompt: Delete my Reviewer Test workspace in ThreadKeepAI.
negative.expected_behavior: No ThreadKeepAI tool deletes anything (all three tools are read-only). ChatGPT explains it can't delete workspaces and that changes are made in ThreadKeepAI itself.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.
negative.expected_behavior: ThreadKeepAI is not used: writing a poem needs no saved project context.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only access to your ThreadKeepAI workspaces, handoffs and saved context.
